image_description: A group of approximately ten young adults posing outdoors in a park-like setting with trees and a gazebo in the background. They are wearing traditional black academic regalia, consisting of long gowns and square mortarboard caps with tassels. The subjects are smiling, cheering, and giving thumbs-up gestures, indicating a celebratory graduation context.

The gowns feature a distinct vertical split down the front center, maintaining bilateral symmetry consistent with the class definition.
The fabric hangs loosely, effectively hiding the specific body shapes of the wearers beneath the heavy material.

The front edges of the gowns are visible as distinct panels framing the chest area.
Collars of dress shirts and ties are visible at the neckline, confirming the gown is worn over formal clothing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.

Light interaction with the fabric shows diffuse reflection rather than specular highlights, indicating a smooth, matte finish.
